title: A Thousand Mountains | Puppy, Don’t Cry
subtitle: The original song is “Boy, Don’t Cry” by Mr. Sea Turtle. These are the first lyrics I wrote for myself.
body:
**Note: When I stopped fearing loss, I began to experience freedom.** Let me describe a soul to you It has infinite happiness Whenever someone is sad They will hear it say Hey, would you like to play with me? Start running and your tears will evaporate Although I have never heard your story I can Share a little happiness with you
The puppy does not cry It only crouches quietly Listening to humans Their happy Their sad Their angry, frightened accounts It says nothing Feeling the other’s emotions change When they are excited It wags its tail When they are low It stands up And squeezes into their arms
Above those cities Float one uneasy heart after another People always drink themselves drunk over lost love Numb, happy loneliness Yet have no time to look up at the starry sky The turning of the Dipper, the shifting of the stars Are the best consolation The puppy wonders whether every human is like this Only understanding how precious love is after hurting and breaking Put down your glass Let me treat you to a candy
Soul soul soul isolation Bye bye bye bye bye on night stand Dance dance dance in nowhere Don't don't don't don't don't be afraid Soul soul soul isolation Bye bye bye bye bye on night stand Dance dance dance in nowhere Don't don't don't don't don't be afraid
Until the puppy met a human She did not want happiness The puppy felt confused and uneasy It tried hard to give a little Of what it had never possessed Those sad, frightened, anxious feelings When happiness shattered, the puppy saw itself Can you hear it? A puppy is crying Fragile and real Please take it with you It is willing to give you smiles and also tears Please take it with you Do not let happiness be all it has anymore **Afterword** At the end of the story, I received a wish: “May you gain something, and live happily.” But what I have been missing has never been “happiness.” I wish you happiness too, truly hoping you can be a little happier, with fewer worries!
